q: Five persons A, B, C, D and E sit in a row facing north. A sits at the left end. B sits to the right of A. C sits between B and D. E sits at the right end. Who sits in the middle?
exp: The arrangement is A-B-C-D-E. Therefore C sits in the middle.

q: Six persons P, Q, R, S, T and U sit in a row facing north. P sits at the extreme left. U sits at the extreme right. Q sits immediately right of P. S sits immediately left of U. R sits between Q and S. Who sits third from the left?
exp: The arrangement is P-Q-R-T-S-U. Therefore R is third from the left.

q: Seven persons A, B, C, D, E, F and G sit in a row facing north. D sits in the middle. A sits second to the left of D. G sits second to the right of D. B sits at the extreme left. F sits immediately right of B. Who sits immediately left of G?
exp: Positions are B-F-A-D-C-G-E. Therefore C sits immediately left of G.

q: Eight persons P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W sit in a row facing north. P sits at the extreme left. W sits at the extreme right. Q sits immediately right of P. R sits third to the right of Q. S sits immediately left of W. T sits between R and S. Who sits fourth from the left?
exp: P is 1st, Q 2nd, U 3rd, R 4th, T 5th, V 6th, S 7th, W 8th. Thus R is fourth from the left.

q: Five people J, K, L, M and N sit in a row facing north. J sits immediately left of K. L sits immediately right of K. M sits at the right end. N sits between L and M. Who sits second from the left?
exp: The arrangement is J-K-L-N-M. Hence K is second from the left.

q: Seven students P, Q, R, S, T, U and V sit in a row facing north. S is fourth from the left. P sits second to the right of S. Q sits immediately left of S. V sits at the extreme right. R sits immediately left of P. Who is at the extreme left?
exp: S is 4th, P is 6th, Q is 3rd, R is 5th, V is 7th. The remaining person U must be 1st.

q: Six persons A, B, C, D, E and F sit in a row facing north. A sits third from the left. B sits immediately to the right of A. C sits at the extreme right. D sits immediately left of E. F is not at an end. Who sits second from the right?
exp: A is 3rd and B is 4th. C is 6th. D-E must occupy 1st-2nd or 4th-5th; since 4th is occupied, D-E are 1st-2nd and F is 5th. Thus E is second from the right.

q: Eight persons A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H sit in a row facing north. H is fourth from the left. C is second to the left of H. A is immediately right of C. F is at the extreme right. B is immediately left of F. G sits between A and H. Who sits third from the right?
exp: Positions: D-C-A-G-H-E-B-F. Third from the right is E.

q: Seven persons M, N, O, P, Q, R and S sit in a row facing north. O sits in the middle. M sits immediately left of O. Q sits immediately right of O. N sits at the extreme left. S sits at the extreme right. Who sits between N and M?
exp: The arrangement is N-P-M-O-Q-R-S. Therefore P sits between N and M.

q: Six persons A, B, C, D, E and F sit in a row facing north. C sits second from the left. E sits second from the right. A sits immediately left of E. F sits at the extreme left. Who sits between C and A?
exp: F-C-B-D-A-E is the valid arrangement. Hence D sits between C and A.

q: Five persons P, Q, R, S and T sit in a row facing north. R sits at the extreme left. T sits at the extreme right. Q sits immediately right of P. S sits between Q and T. Who sits in the middle?
exp: The arrangement is R-P-Q-S-T. Q is in the middle.

q: Eight persons J, K, L, M, N, O, P and Q sit in a row facing north. J sits at one end. K sits immediately right of J. L sits third to the right of K. M sits immediately left of Q. P sits at the other end. O sits between L and M. Who sits fifth from the left?
exp: J-K-N-L-O-M-Q-P is the only arrangement satisfying the conditions. Therefore O is fifth from the left.

q: Six persons P, Q, R, S, T and U sit in a row facing north. Q is second from the left. T is second from the right. P sits immediately left of T. U sits immediately right of Q. Who sits at the extreme left?
exp: Q is 2nd and U is 3rd. T is 5th and P is 4th. Therefore R and S occupy 1st and 6th.

q: Five persons A, B, C, D and E sit in a row facing north. B sits to the left of C but to the right of A. D sits to the right of C. E sits to the left of A. Who is second from the right?
exp: The order is E-A-B-C-D. Therefore C is second from the right.

q: Seven persons P, Q, R, S, T, U and V sit in a row facing north. P is fourth from the left. Q sits immediately left of P. R sits immediately right of P. S is second from the left. V is at the extreme right. T sits between R and V. Who is at the extreme left?
exp: P=4th, Q=3rd, R=5th, S=2nd, V=7th, T=6th. U must be 1st, so U is at the extreme left.

q: Six persons A, B, C, D, E and F sit in a row facing north. A sits immediately right of B. C sits immediately right of A. D sits immediately left of E. F sits at the extreme left. Who sits between C and E?
exp: F-B-A-C-D-E is the arrangement. D sits between C and E.

q: In a row of six persons, P is taller than Q, Q is taller than R, S is taller than P, T is shorter than R, and U is taller than S. Who is the tallest?
exp: The order is U > S > P > Q > R > T. Hence U is tallest.

q: Six persons A, B, C, D, E and F have different heights. A is taller than B but shorter than C. D is shorter than B but taller than E. F is taller than C. Who is the shortest?
exp: The order is F > C > A > B > D > E. Therefore E is shortest.

q: Seven persons P, Q, R, S, T, U and V have different ages. P is older than Q, R is older than P, S is younger than Q, T is older than R, U is younger than S, and V is younger than T but older than R. Who is the oldest?
exp: T > V > R > P > Q > S > U. Therefore T is oldest.

q: Five books A, B, C, D and E are arranged from heaviest to lightest. A is heavier than B. C is lighter than D but heavier than E. B is heavier than D. Which book is the lightest?
exp: A > B > D > C > E. Therefore E is the lightest.

q: Seven students sit in a row facing north. A sits immediately to the right of B. C sits immediately to the left of D. E sits at the extreme left. F sits between D and G. If B is third from the left, who is fourth from the left?
exp: B is 3rd, so A is 4th. Therefore A sits fourth from the left.

q: Eight persons P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W sit in a row facing north. P is third from the left. Q sits immediately right of P. R sits at the extreme left. S sits immediately left of T. U sits between Q and S. V sits immediately right of T. Who is at the extreme right?
exp: R-P-Q-U-S-T-V occupy positions 1 to 7, leaving W at position 8. Therefore W is at the extreme right.

q: Four persons A, B, C and D sit in a row facing north. A is not at an end. B sits immediately left of C. D is at the extreme right. Who sits at the extreme left?
exp: Since D is 4th and B-C are consecutive, A cannot be 1st or 4th. Thus B-C must be 2nd-3rd and A is 1st. Therefore A is at the extreme left.

q: Five persons P, Q, R, S and T sit in a row facing north. Q sits at the extreme left. R is immediately right of S. T is immediately left of P. If S is not at an end, who sits in the middle?
exp: With Q at 1st, S-R must occupy 2nd-3rd or 3rd-4th. T-P occupy the remaining two places. For S not at an end, the valid arrangement is Q-S-R-T-P, so S is in the middle.

q: Six persons A, B, C, D, E and F sit in a row facing north. A sits second from the left. F sits second from the right. B sits somewhere to the left of C. D sits immediately right of E. Who can sit at the extreme left?
exp: A is fixed at 2nd and F at 5th. Since B must be left of C and D-E must be consecutive, B can occupy the extreme left in a valid arrangement.

q: Six persons A, B, C sit in the first row facing south, and D, E, F sit in the second row facing north. In Row 1, A sits in the middle and B sits to the left of A. In Row 2, D sits opposite A and E sits to the right of D. Who sits opposite B?
exp: Row 1, from left to right, is B-A-C. Row 2, from left to right, is D-E-F because D is opposite A and E is to D's right. Therefore F is opposite B.

q: Six persons P, Q, R sit in the first row facing south, and S, T, U sit in the second row facing north. P sits in the middle of the first row. S sits opposite P. Q sits to the left of P. Who sits opposite Q?
exp: Since the first row faces south, Q is visually to the left of P but corresponds to the right position from the second row's perspective. With S opposite P, T must occupy the position opposite Q.

q: Eight persons A, B, C, D sit in one row facing north and E, F, G, H sit in another row facing south. A sits opposite E, B opposite F, and C opposite G. D sits immediately right of C. Who sits opposite D?
exp: A-E, B-F and C-G are opposite pairs. D is the fourth position in the first row, so H is the fourth position opposite D.

q: Eight persons P, Q, R, S sit in one row facing north and T, U, V, W sit in another row facing south. P sits opposite T, Q opposite U, and S opposite W. R sits immediately left of S. Who sits opposite R?
exp: P-T, Q-U and S-W are opposite pairs. Since R is immediately left of S, R occupies the third position, so V is opposite R.

q: Ten persons A, B, C, D, E in Row 1 face south and P, Q, R, S, T in Row 2 face north. A is at the left end of Row 1. P sits opposite A. B sits immediately right of A. Q sits opposite B. Who sits opposite C?
exp: A-P and B-Q are opposite pairs. C is the third position in Row 1, so R is the third position in Row 2 and sits opposite C.

q: Seven persons J, K, L, M, N, O and P sit in a row facing north. M sits in the middle. J sits second to the left of M. K sits immediately left of J. N sits immediately right of M. O sits at the extreme right. Who sits between J and M?
exp: M is 4th, J is 2nd, K is 1st, N is 5th, O is 7th. Therefore P and L occupy 3rd and 6th. Since the person between J (2nd) and M (4th) is at 3rd, that person is P.

q: Five persons A, B, C, D and E sit in a row facing north. A is taller than B but shorter than C. D is shorter than B but taller than E. If the people are arranged from tallest to shortest, who sits second?
exp: The order is C > A > B > D > E. Therefore A is second.

q: Six persons P, Q, R, S, T and U sit in a row. P sits to the left of Q. R sits to the right of Q. S sits between P and Q. T sits to the left of P. U sits at the extreme right. Who sits third from the left?
exp: The order is T-P-S-Q-R-U. Therefore P is third from the left.

q: Seven persons A, B, C, D, E, F and G sit in a row facing north. C is third from the left. A is immediately left of C. B is immediately right of C. D is at the extreme right. E sits between B and D. F sits at the extreme left. Who sits between A and B?
exp: A-C-B are consecutive, so C sits between A and B.
